name: loka-wikidata-v8
notes: Same 44.5M-parameter BPE architecture as v6/v7 (d_model 512, 6 layers, 50K BPE vocab). Trained 20 epochs from random init on the 184,458-triple v7-cleaned corpus (Wikidata external-id, url, commonsMedia, math, lexeme/sense/form/entity-schema, globe-coordinate, geo-shape, musical-notation, tabular-data datatypes excluded; time and quantity literals normalised; monolingualtext kept across all languages with @lang stripped). Final epoch-20 perplexity 64.65 (v6 was 194.98 on a 4x larger noisy corpus, v7 was 192.63 on the same v7 corpus at 5 epochs). Loss was still descending at epoch 20 — the v7 corpus is not data-saturated yet at this model size. v8 inference qualitatively dominant over v6/v7 on the standard Q42-seed propgen test: 47 emissions, 40 of them on semantic predicates (vs v6's 31 of 52, v7's 5 of 14), and the catalog-format leak that defined v6 (instance of -> '+ Ġof - 00 - 03 T 00') stays at zero. See DEVLOG.md for the full v6 -> v7 -> v8 trajectory and paper §5.5 / §5.6.
